title: Horses of Fire All Around
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks and sees, and tonight a scared young man has his eyes opened to hills full of horses and chariots of fire: Scout, alone in a dark hallway, prays, looks again, and finds help was there all along.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a seeker looks for what is really there, and tonight a scared young man learns to look again. In Scout’s world today: the hallway is dark, and Scout feels all alone on the way to get a drink. Scout stops and says a quick prayer, then looks again. The little light is glowing, Dad’s door is open, and the puppy is right there. Just like Elisha’s helper seeing the hills full of fire, Scout learned that there is more help around us than we can see.
